sources.snippet: A note on naming: searches for "Qwen 3.6 Heretic" and "Qwen 3.6 Obliterated" point at the same family. Heretic is the decensoring method popularised on the Gemma line and now applied to Qwen; Obliterated is simply a common misspelling of abliterated. All three terms land you at the huihui-ai and richardyoung Qwen 3.6 variants above.
